result.title: Quarry Steps Up (A Tony Quarry / North Carolina Mystery Book 1)
result.features: When Tony Quarry finds a young Mexican runaway hiding behind his barn and decides to help him, there's no going back. The boy, Primo Estrada, separated from his mother during a tumultuous border crossing three years earlier, has been under the control of the treacherous Tercero Colina since. At first, Quarry's reluctant to get involved in Primo's plight. He's rebuilt his life in a small North Carolina town after serving a prison term for the accidental death of a college student in a barroom brawl.But when Colina tries to reclaim Primo, Quarry protects him. He is determined to not abandon Primo as his own parents gave up on him, and to stand up for the right thing regardless of cost. Furious, Colina hires Salvadoran criminals Martillo and Clavo Cuna - "the Hammer and the Nail." Quarry is forced to draw on all his resources, including a local priest and a former prison cellmate, to protect Primo. Everything he values is at risk when the Cunas raise the stakes, culminating in a violent confrontation at Quarry's farmhouse.

The two customer reviews for "Quarry Steps Up" are overwhelmingly positive, with both reviewers giving the book a 5-star rating.

Some key points highlighted in the reviews:

- The reviewer praised the author's "exactness to his dialogue that avoids cultural stereotypes" and the "intrigue and emotion that he shepherds throughout the novel with a caring and balanced writer's hand."

- They commented on the strong pacing and structure of the novel, saying "the key to McCarthy's writing is his natural, and by that I mean unforced, approach towards pace and structure." This allowed the characters to develop naturally without sacrificing the narrative storytelling.

- One reviewer felt the book had "something for every kind of reader whether you like mystery, drama, humor or romance" and was "hooked from page 1", eagerly anticipating the next book in the series.

- Both reviewers described the book as a "great first novel" and a "WOW!" of a read, indicating the author's strong debut effort in the crime fiction genre.

The overwhelmingly positive feedback from these verified purchaser reviews suggests this book could be an excellent choice that aligns well with your interest in crime fiction with complex characters and an engaging plot. Let me know if you have any other questions!

top_reviews.title: A strong first novel
top_reviews.text:
R.J. McCarthy brings the reader into the world of Tony Quarry through a welcomed opening door rather than a shoehorned approach to fitting the reader into an uncomfortable position.

The Novelist demonstrates a cache of promising qualities including an exactness to his dialogue that avoids cultural stereotypes, intrigue and emotion that he shephards throughout the novel with a caring and balanced writers hand.

For me the key success factor to this first work was pace. While the aforementioned many luminescent qualities evoke from his work, the key to McCarthy's writing is his natural, and by that I mean unforced, approach towards pace and structure. It is this foundation that allows the characters of Tony and Primo to develop their friendship/adventures throughout the story while allowing each room in the storytelling to tackle their own fears internally while working towards achieving the novel's very heart felt conclusion. Never at any point does it feel like this is being achieved by sacrificing narrative storytelling. The writing is tight and concise with no hand holding and as a reader you can comfortably leave your suspension of disbelief at the front door before you step into this world.

This is a great first novel and now we have had a peak into the world of Tony Quarry, lets look forward to more adventures to flesh out and develop this intriguing character further and further into the future.

top_reviews.title: WOW!
top_reviews.text: I read this book over a year ago and thought I had submitted a review. I realized I hadn't when looking for more books by this author. This was the first time I had read anything by R J McCarthy and I was hooked from page 1. It was well written with something for every kind of reader whether you like mystery, drama, humor or romance. I thoroughly enjoyed the book and am looking forward to the next installment of the Tony Quarry series!
